The smaller worn sweatshirt has the same abstract torn-paper collage graphic centered on the chest. At the bottom center, add 2 lines of small white copy text: “Made for comfort, worn for confidence.” and “Because life feels better when someone’s carrying the weight of the world.” The image should feel like a premium conceptual streetwear campaign from the early 1990s reimagined as contemporary luxury advertising, with crisp studio lighting, soft shadows, subtle floor reflections, precise product focus, surreal scale contrast between the oversized sweatshirt and the model, and a polished magazine-poster aesthetic.\

title: 三幅少女屋顶漫画

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a polished black-and-white manga two-page-spread style comic page based on a simple one-page scene, drawn as a clean shoujo manga manuscript with delicate pen hatching, screentone-free ink linework, warm off-white paper texture, and thin black panel borders.

Canvas: Vertical page, about 3:4 aspect ratio, with three wide horizontal panels stacked from top to bottom. Use a hand-drawn manga border around each panel and slight paper grain. Overall mood is romantic, emotional, and gently dramatic.

Character: A cute teenage schoolgirl, unnamed schoolgirl, with light-colored hair in twin braids, straight bangs, a thick headband, small ribbon bows tied into the braids, large sparkling shoujo eyes, soft blush, and a sailor-style school uniform. She wears small cross-shaped earrings and carries a rectangular school bag with a cross charm. Her expression changes from worried hesitation to determined resolve to a confident, tender smile.

Layout and panel count: Use exactly 3 panels.
1. Top panel: A rooftop or elevated school terrace at sunset, city buildings in the distance, metal railings, drifting flower petals, soft clouds, and a calm wind. The girl leans on the railing in three-quarter view, resting one hand near her mouth in hesitation. Add an oval vertical Japanese speech bubble on the right containing exactly: 「…さっき、言いすぎたかな…」. Place a soft gray rectangular blur censor over the center of her face, obscuring facial features in this panel.
2. Middle panel: The same girl suddenly stands and moves forward with determination, holding or pulling up her school bag at her side. Use strong manga speed lines radiating from the background to show a decision moment. Add an oval vertical Japanese speech bubble on the right containing exactly: 「大丈夫。明日ちゃんと伝えよう。」. Place a soft gray rectangular blur censor over the center of her face, obscuring facial features in this panel.
3. Bottom panel: Close-up of the girl’s face, now uncensored and clearly visible, with sparkling eyes, blush marks, tiny heart highlights around her cheeks and hair, and a small confident smile while she lightly touches or holds her cross earring. Add an oval vertical Japanese speech bubble on the right containing exactly: 「私のやり方で、もう一度。」.

Visual style: Fine monochrome manga ink, expressive shoujo eyes, delicate crosshatching, clean contour lines, natural hand-drawn imperfections, subtle sunset atmosphere rendered only through linework, no color except the off-white paper background and gray face-censor blocks in the first two panels.

Constraints: Keep exactly 3 panels, exactly 3 speech bubbles, and exactly 2 gray face-obscuring rectangles. Do not add extra characters, extra captions, logos, watermarks, or modern UI elements. Preserve the Japanese text exactly as written.\

prompt_en: Create a black-and-white manga page with 4 stacked horizontal panels, clean black gutters, screentone shading, dramatic speed lines, and polished seinen-style linework. The page features two youthful anime characters with modern casual clothing and short dark hair, with the face area of both characters obscured by a soft square blur censor block. Panel 1: a slim young person with messy short dark hair and a collared shirt clenches one fist near their chest, body angled left, surrounded by an intense fiery aura effect in the background, looking emotional and defensive. On the right side, place a large jagged vertical speech balloon containing this Japanese text: 「何十時間も魂を削って描いた一枚と、プロンプト打ち込んで数秒で出した画像が同じ価値なわけないでしょ！ふざけないで！」. Add a rounded rectangular speech box on the right with this Japanese text: 「投下した労働時間で価値が決まるという典型的な“労働価値説の誤謬”だ。市場における価値は、出力された結果を受け手がどう評価するかで決まる」. title: 上海工业园区偷拍
author: ToroJushiAi
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,肖像 / 自拍,城市景观 / 街景
prompt_en:
A natural candid moment captured in authentic daily life photography, shot at extreme close range inside a 1933 Shanghai industrial complex. The camera presses intimately close to the subject's face, which rests against a vast rust-stained cast iron wall whose surface dominates the frame — a landscape of deep ochre, burnt umber, and oxidized copper-green patina alive with peeling rust flakes, ancient bolt-heads, and streaked mineral deposits.

The young Japanese woman appears to be in her early twenties, her fair translucent cool-beige skin — somewhere in the NC10 to NC15 range — rendered with visible skin subsurface scattering beneath the hard directional window light, warmth diffusing softly beneath the surface. Specular micro-highlights catch precisely on her cheekbones and along her narrow nose ridge, and fine foundation powder grain is perceptible in the brightest zones of her skin. Her almond-shaped eyes carry soft natural single eyelids, and her refined nose tip holds a clean, delicate line against the corroded iron behind her.

The leather jacket collar is barely visible at the lower edge of the frame, its dark material grazing the jaw line in an unplanned, not geometrically symmetrical way. Two or three stray hairs from her fine straight black hair have been displaced by the faintest air movement, lying loosely across her cheek and temple — a natural imperfection that grounds the image in a real, unrepeatable instant. Her head tilts slightly back, her eyes closed, her expression drawn inward into some private quiet state. The grid pattern of a nearby window casts strong, high-contrast bars of light and shadow directly across her face, fracturing it into warm illuminated planes and deep cool shadow.

The light is hard and architectural, sourced from industrial-paned glass somewhere off-frame, creating a theatrical chiaroscuro that feels accidental rather than arranged. Subtle ISO 400 film grain is visible throughout the shadow areas — photographic noise texture, not CG render smoothness — embedding the image in an analog sensibility that honors the century-old space around her. Aspect ratio 2:3. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.\

Layout: Place the oversized black ink calligraphy wordmark in the center, spanning most of the width. The two discrete main characters are: 1) left character “晓”, 2) right character “峰”. Below the wordmark, add a small red square seal centered, then widely spaced romanization “XIAO FENG”, then a thin divider line with “晓 · 峰”, then small English text “DAWN PEAK”. Use muted gray and cinnabar red for all annotation lines and seals.

Top-left branding: Add small vertical/stacked Chinese text “学生万象”, a short horizontal divider line, then “品牌标识提案”, and small English text “IDENTITY DESIGN”. Keep it light gray, tiny, and aligned near the upper-left margin.

Top-right motto: Add a narrow vertical Chinese phrase near the upper-right edge: “晓启乾坤  峰立云间”, with a tiny red seal stamp beneath it.

Annotation system: Use exactly 4 visible analysis modules around the main wordmark. 1) Upper-right stroke callout: circle the top peak-like stroke of the right character, connect it with thin red leader lines to the label “细节解析”. 2) Right inset box: a thin red square frame containing an enlarged cropped black brush stroke from the character “峰”, with the label “提气笔” and small text “峰顶意象” below. 3) Right explanatory card: a pale gray rectangular text box titled “设计说明”, containing several short Chinese paragraphs and exactly 4 numbered red bullet points. 4) Bottom-left circular detail: a round magnified crop of the lower-left internal structure of “晓”, showing a small sunrise-like white semicircle and fine black rays, with a nearby title “设计说明” and short explanatory paragraph.

Additional lower-right structure diagram: Add a very light technical construction sketch labeled “字形结构” and “STRUCTURE”, showing thin pale gray outline strokes of the wordmark, partially transparent and subordinate to the main design.

The left character should contain a subtle dawn/sunrise motif in its lower inner opening: a pale cream semicircle rising from a dark horizontal base, with fine short rays above it.

Use black ink for the main wordmark, warm gray for body text, and muted red for seals, labels, leader lines, circles, and numbering.

prompt_en: 请生成一张高完成度的「城市线描图鉴海报 / Urban Line Atlas Poster」。nn这张图基于“单色城市线描旅行海报”的视觉语言进行设计，包含顶部大标题、中部街景纵深、核心地标、左右建筑、前景人物、底部落款的完整构图结构。nn【主题城市】n城市名称：伊春（Yichun）n英文主标题：FOREST LINE ATLAS / YICHUN CHRONICLEn中文标题：伊春 · 森林之城n国家 / 地区：中国 黑龙江省n核心地标：小兴安岭森林、红松林海、五营国家森林公园观景塔n街区场景：林区小城街道、带木质建筑的居民街口、林业城市氛围n情绪主题：清晨薄雾中的通勤时刻n主色调：墨绿 + 深灰线描n画幅比例：3:4竖版nn【整体定位】n这是一张兼具旅行纪念海报、城市视觉图鉴、建筑线描手稿和编辑设计封面的作品。画面需要呈现伊春“森林中的城市”这一独特气质，既有城市识别度，又有真实街头生活感，不是普通旅游海报，也不是单一地标插画，而是一张具有收藏价值的城市档案视觉作品。n【构图设计】n顶部为强标题区，使用大字号英文标题「FOREST LINE ATLAS」，辅以副标题「YICHUN CHRONICLE」，可加入编号系统（如 No. CN-HLJ-YC-01）与简要坐标信息，排版现代且具有设计感。n中部为城市街景主体，采用街道纵深透视构图，视角略微仰视，道路向远方延伸并逐渐进入森林区域。n核心地标为远景中的森林观景塔或小兴安岭林海轮廓，清晰但不过度突出，自然融入街景。n左右两侧加入本地建筑细节：木质房屋、林业局风格建筑、居民楼、小商铺、公交站、路灯、电线杆、简洁路牌等，形成高密度城市信息。n前景加入生活元素：穿秋冬服装的行人、骑自行车的人、拎购物袋的居民、小型车辆，地面有落叶增强季节氛围。n底部设置独立落款区，设计为城市档案标签结构，包含「YICHUN / HEILONGJIANG / CHINA」以及简化城市信息模块或地图索引风格排版。n【文字系统】n顶部主标题清晰醒目。画面中仅保留2–4处清晰可读文字（如“伊春站”“林业路”“公交站”），其余招牌使用抽象化中文笔画或符号化字符，避免乱码。整体文字系统需统一、克制，并融入设计结构中。n【视觉风格】n整体采用单色或极少量双色线描风格，背景为米白或暖白纸张质感。线条精密、干净、有层次，具有建筑钢笔手稿感与丝网印刷质感。近景线条略粗，远景线条更细，人物与物件简洁但可辨识，整体风格克制高级。nn【创新要求】n在以下方面进行设计变化：标题命名系统、顶部排版结构、街景轻微仰视视角、森林与城市融合构图、底部档案式信息模块、秋季落叶氛围表达。n【避免事项】n不要普通旅游海报风格，不要水彩、厚涂、卡通Q版，不要赛博朋克，不要高饱和色彩，不要廉价纪念品风格。nn请生成一张独立完整、高清、线条清晰、具有收藏感与系列辨识度的竖版城市线描海报。

title: 电影火焰厨师故事板
author: @SHARA
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,摄影,电影感 / 电影剧照,美食 / 饮品
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a cinematic storyboard contact sheet for THE FLAME CHEF, a high-energy 15-second cooking film showing a dramatic progression from raw heat and ingredients to a finished plated dish.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 image formatted as a 10-panel grid, exactly 2 rows by 5 columns, with thin clean white gutters separating every panel. Each panel is a vertical cinematic frame with shallow depth of field, rich warm amber highlights, deep black shadows, steam, sparks, and natural film grain.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic food cinematography shot as if on ARRI Alexa 35 with a 35mm lens, fast rhythmic pacing implied through motion blur, whip-pan energy, speed-ramp frozen moments, dramatic kitchen lighting, glossy sauces, firelight, smoke, bokeh, and high contrast. No text overlays, no logos, no watermark.

Panel count and sequence: Use exactly 10 discrete scenes.
1. Top-left: Close-up of a chef’s hand gripping a pan handle over a blue gas flame; the empty black wok or skillet steams in warm darkness.
2. Top row second: Overhead close-up of hands chopping fresh ingredients on a wooden board: red peppers, sliced garlic, green herbs, and small diced red aromatics scattered dramatically.
3. Top row third: A cube of butter suspended midair above a hot pan, with another cube melting and bubbling below, droplets and golden reflections visible.
4. Top row fourth: A wok toss over open flames, vegetables and ingredients flying upward in an arc, orange fire licking beneath the pan.
5. Top-right: Extreme macro of garlic cloves and dried red chilies sizzling in vigorously bubbling oil, with steam and golden oil highlights.
6. Bottom-left: Chef’s torso and hand sprinkling a cascade of coarse salt or seasoning downward through a dark smoky beam of light.
7. Bottom row second: Close-up of glossy dark red-brown chili glaze being poured from a spoon onto a mound of cooked vegetables or meat in a bowl.
8. Bottom row third: Finished stir-fry in a dark bowl, topped with abundant fresh cilantro leaves; red peppers, seared pieces, glossy sauce, and steam are visible.
9. Bottom row fourth: Chef’s hand wiping the rim of the plated dish with a white cloth, refining presentation in a smoky low-lit kitchen.
10. Bottom-right: Hero final plate under a single overhead spotlight, steaming dramatically on a dark table, chef silhouette blurred in the background.

Subject details: The chef is mostly anonymous, visible only through hands, torso, or silhouette; focus on kinetic cooking artistry, flames, steam, fresh herbs, garlic, chilies, peppers, butter, oil, sauce, and final plating. Make the finished dish look like spicy flame-seared stir-fry with rich warm colors and restaurant-level plating.

Constraints: Maintain the exact 2x5 layout and exactly 10 panels. Keep the palette warm, cinematic, and moody. Preserve realistic food textures and motion. Do not add captions, subtitles, interface elements, or extra panels.\

He faces a dense neon-lit urban street packed with pedestrians, old shopfronts, hanging signs, tangled cables, weathered apartment buildings, and a tram approaching from the center distance. Overlay a complete game HUD: top left circular character portrait with the name 龍少爺, level 36, 3 horizontal status bars; top center compass with N and E markers plus the location text and a clock reading 14:35; top right circular minimap with icons; right side quest tracker panel containing 3 quest groups with Chinese text, with the top highlighted quest header in orange; bottom left semi-transparent chat box with 4 colored lines of Chinese system and world chat plus a text entry bar and a send button; bottom center hotbar with 7 skill slots labeled 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, Q, E, R, including a large ornate circular ultimate icon at the center and one glowing purple skill icon; bottom right 5 menu icons with Chinese labels for character, inventory, quests, friends, and settings, plus a small ESC indicator. Goal: Create a vertical premium coffee shop grand-opening promotional poster for 牛顿咖啡, with a warm beige marble-paper background, brown typography, taped paper collage elements, and a realistic mall storefront mockup in the center.

Canvas: Portrait poster, 2:3 ratio, high resolution. Use an elegant cream, caramel, coffee-brown, and warm gold palette. The overall mood is modern Chinese commercial advertising, cozy, polished, and upscale.

Top section: Center a simple coffee-cup logo with steam above the brand name 牛顿咖啡 and small English text “NEWTON COFFEE”. Below it place spaced uppercase text “NEW STORE OPENS”. The main oversized headline should read 拍围挡 · 喝咖啡 in bold dark-brown Chinese serif display type.

Coupon banner: Under the headline, add a torn white paper strip taped at the upper-right corner with beige masking tape. On the left of the strip draw a small line-art steaming cup and handwritten “Enjoy!”. In the center place a huge “1000”. On the right place Chinese and English offer text: “杯免费送”, “FREE COFFEE”, “FREE COFFEE”.

Central storefront scene: Create a realistic curved mall construction hoarding / storefront wall with glossy floor reflections and glass mall architecture behind it. The hoarding is wrapped in coffee-themed graphics with swirling latte foam and marble textures. It contains exactly 5 visible collage areas: 1) left vertical torn-edge coffee photo showing latte art in a cup, 2) small taped left notice reading “新店开业 / 1000杯 / 免费送 / FREE COFFEE”, 3) large central cream panel with the logo, brand name, and handwritten slogan 好咖啡，这里喝得到！, 4) right taped notice reading “NEW STORE OPENS / 2026 / 6/9 / 我们在这里等你”, 5) lower-right torn photo of a warm coffee shop interior with a small cup illustration beside it.

Central feature icons: Along the bottom of the large central panel, show exactly 3 minimal brown line icons with labels: 1) coffee bean icon labeled “现磨咖啡 / FRESHLY GROUND”, 2) milk carton icon labeled “鲜奶拿铁 / FRESH MILK LATTE”, 3) dessert cloche icon labeled “手作甜点 / HANDMADE DESSERT”.

Instruction section below storefront: On a clean cream background, create exactly 3 horizontal participation steps separated by arrows: 1) camera icon with “拍围挡打卡”, 2) cup icon with “领免费咖啡”, 3) smiley icon with “进店体验”. Beneath the steps, add two centered lines of smaller Chinese instruction text: “拍下围挡任意角度照片，发布至社交平台并带话题 #牛顿咖啡新店开业#” and “即可到店领取免费咖啡一杯！每日限量，先到先得！”

Bottom information row: Create exactly 3 information blocks with thin vertical dividers: 1) location pin icon, “牛顿商场名”, “NEWTON MALL”; 2) stacked-floor icon, “L1层”, “LEVEL L1”; 3) calendar icon, 2026 - 6 - 9, “盛大开业”. At the very bottom add handwritten Chinese text “牛顿喝了都说好的咖啡” with a casual underline.

Visual style: Elegant Chinese coffee retail poster, photorealistic storefront mockup combined with paper collage, torn paper edges, masking tape, soft shadows, warm lighting, subtle marble texture, coffee foam swirls, refined typography, balanced central alignment.

Constraints: Keep all listed text legible and in the same approximate positions. Use exactly 3 feature icons, exactly 3 participation steps, exactly 3 bottom information blocks, and exactly 5 visible collage areas on the storefront. No extra logos, no watermark, no QR code.\

prompt_en: Create a warm nostalgic Japanese-style portrait photograph of a young Asian woman around 18 to 20 years old sitting by a rustic wooden flower-shop counter in bright morning sunlight. She has fair translucent skin, delicate soft facial features, clear smiling eyes looking directly into the camera, and a gentle closed-mouth smile. Her dark brown long straight hair with airy bangs and a low side ponytail over one shoulder catches the sunlight with subtle golden-brown highlights, and a single yellow daisy flower tucked behind her ear adds a sweet girlish accent. She wears a soft yellow cardigan over a cream lace-trim camisole with a small delicate necklace. Her hand rests naturally near a bouquet of orange roses on the wooden counter. In the background, include dark vertical weathered wood planks and one small chalkboard sign with faint handwritten shop hours and prices, slightly out of focus. Use a close-up vertical composition, chest-up framing, shallow depth of field, soft bloom, sun-dappled highlights, gentle lens haze, warm film colors, early-2000s Japanese magazine aesthetic, romantic and innocent mood, high detail skin texture but flattering, natural makeup, no extra people, no modern objects, no watermark, no legible text beyond vague chalk marks.\
